title: Leaf APS broker attribution ledger line (CONTRACT-ADDENDUM §8, FROZEN 2026-07-22)
description: Exactly ONE such JSON object per line of broker_ledger.jsonl (env BROKER_LEDGER), appended by server/broker.py for EVERY POST /broker/run — including kill-switch and quota denials. The nine properties below are guaranteed present on every line; additions are allowed only as new OPTIONAL keys (additive evolution), never by renaming, retyping, or dropping a frozen key. Consumers: da/usage.py (spend caps §1a, daily run quota §1d, /api/usage aggregation §13).

ts.description: Append time, UNIX epoch seconds (time.time()). The UTC-day bucket key for the daily run quota and the today/total split in /api/usage.

tenant_id.description: The tenant the run is attributed to (request body tenant_id; every metering read filters on equality).

tool.description: tool package `name` (null when the request carried no usable tool package).

aps_endpoint.description: The APS base URL this broker process targets (constant per process).

aps_live.description: True iff the run was requested against real APS (APS-money path). Metered quotas count ONLY aps_live:true lines; APS_LIVE=0 runs are un-metered/free.

engine_seconds.description: Engine time reported by the run's cost block; null when the path yields no cost (mock, denial, failure before execution).

usd_est.description: Estimated spend in USD from the run's cost block; null when unknown. Spend aggregation sums non-null values on non-denied lines.

status.description: 'ok' for a successful envelope; otherwise the §10 error_code of the returned envelope (e.g. TENANT_DISABLED, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, BAD_PARAMS, WORKITEM_FAILED) or 'INTERNAL' for an unhandled exception. Denial statuses (TENANT_DISABLED, QUOTA_EXCEEDED) are excluded from spend/run counting.
